summary: The candidate substantively budgets the legacy AITER workspace and uses one exact sizing helper for budgeting and allocation. Deterministic issue-shaped arithmetic, focused tests, and a real gfx950 allocation passed, but the exact MI355X Qwen serving cases were unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: Pre-fix behavior with the candidate reservation disabled: 2,235,118 KV tokens, 4,096 requests, 69,793,218,560 workspace bytes, and 69,793,139,393 bytes of budget overcommit.
Candidate behavior: 1,669,878 KV tokens, 3,261 requests, 55,565,352,960 workspace bytes, and 79,167 bytes headroom.
45 tests and 9 subtests passed, including sizing arithmetic, request floor/ceiling, explicit request limit, and existing pool configurator coverage.
On MI350X gfx950, production helper size equaled the actual 65,495,040-byte uint8 allocation and boundary writes returned 17 and 29.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack- allocated 65,495,040 bytes using the candidate production sizing helper and passed boundary writes.

remaining_counterexamples: The exact Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 serving command on a 288 GiB MI355X was not run because the model weights and architecture were unavailable.
The online quark_mxfp4 reproduction was not run.
No multi-GPU or distributed workload was exercised.
The candidate reproduction script is not directly runnable on the recorded base because it patches a candidate-added method; failing-before was measured by disabling that method at the candidate.
remaining_limitations: One 252 GiB MI350X gfx950 was available instead of the reported MI355X environment.
GPU evidence validates exact workspace allocation sizing, not full model startup or semantic accuracy.
No native sources changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
